$comment: RC2 §16: the allowed durable telemetry field list and the explicit forbidden-content list, made concrete as fixtures rather than left as prose. Acceptance criterion 7 requires no request or answer content appear in infrastructure logs, traces, error reports, analytics, or provider-retained data.
forbidden_content_that_must_never_appear: message.content or any history entry's content (the guest's actual question/conversation)
source titles or any source/action label text
a guest's name, email, or any other PII

page_context.path's query string (page_context itself never has one per §9.1, but a website-side access log for the underlying page view might — that's explicitly called out as needing separate redaction)
any URL beyond what the response itself already approved for display
a model prompt or system prompt fragment
a JWT, its claims, or any part of the Authorization header
an internal exception message, stack trace, or hostname

session_id_digest_rule.join_prohibition: must not be joined to a guest identity, authenticated session, advertising identifier, or marketing profile
